name: [Copilot Fiscal] WF-01: Document Intake & Extraction Pipeline

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  id: $json.documentId,
  business_id: $json.businessId,
  type: 'invoice',
  direction: 'expense',
  storage_path: $json.storagePath,
  original_filename: $json.originalFilename,
  mime_type: $json.mimeType,
  status: 'EXTRACTING',
  status_updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  document_id: $json.documentId,
  provider: 'openai-vision',
  model: $json.modelUsed || 'gpt-4o-mini',
  prompt_version: 'v1.0',
  extraction_version: 'v1',
  raw_payload: $json.rawPayload || {},
  confidence: $json.confidence,
  extracted_date: $json.extracted.date || null,
  extracted_supplier_name: $json.extracted.supplier_name,
  extracted_supplier_nif: $json.extracted.supplier_nif || null,
  extracted_invoice_number: $json.extracted.invoice_number || null,
  extracted_base_amount: $json.extracted.base_amount,
  extracted_vat_rate: $json.extracted.vat_rate,
  extracted_vat_amount: $json.extracted.vat_amount,
  extracted_total_amount: $json.extracted.total_amount,
  extracted_description: $json.extracted.description,
  extraction_warnings: $json.warnings || [],
  is_active: true
}) }}
